title: Corpus Ship/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Dialogue spoken by captured Solaris and floating displays. Male Solaris captive 1 was voiced by Oliver Koppert. Female Solaris captive is voiced by Gemma Laurelle.
- Nef Anyo: "Like you, I toiled, friends, but I pulled myself up, dusted myself off, and purchased my future."
- Parvos Granum: "Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms."
- Parvos Granum: "Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward."
- Parvos Granum: "Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire."
- Parvos Granum: "Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise."
- Parvos Granum: "Beware the idle man who would lull you back into idleness."
- Parvos Granum: "Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires."
- Parvos Granum: "Charity is power. More charity is more power."
- Parvos Granum: "Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man."
- Parvos Granum: "Fulfill desire and others will follow."
- Parvos Granum: "Ours is the grasping golden hand. We are desire. We are Corpus."
- Parvos Granum: "Day after day we toiled, my father, my brother Cladius, pulling grains for the Orokin takers in the city, as our kind had done for generations."
- Parvos Granum: "The more we toiled the more impatient I grew. A fire raged inside me. I wanted more. I deserved more."
- Parvos Granum: "The city. Those towers. I was struck with awe. What glorious totems of greed those Orokin had built. Built on. Our. Backs."
- Parvos Granum: "I was brash and bold. I struck at midday. I cried, "I take what I am owed!" as I ripped jewels from their tower gates and ran."

- Parvos Granum: "I crawled back to the fields, where I collapsed before my father and brother. I was so near death they had read my Nava rites. My brother Claudius bemoaned me as a fool. How could I have abandoned them?"

- Parvos Granum: "Moving swiftly away from sick-bed to field, I fell to my knees beneath that relentless sun, my chest afire. As it moved to my throat, robbing me of breath, certain death had finally found me, I made one last heave. I spat it out."
- Parvos Granum: "In desire I was wealthy, but in strategy I was empty-handed. I listened for the whisper, it said: "Money begets money.""
- Parvos Granum: "In time my money multiplied into multitudes. With this wealth, I made my body whole again. Then news came: father had collapsed in the field."
- Parvos Granum: "Claudius begged me to stop my mega-dozers, "If you build a city on these fields what will we eat?""
- Parvos Granum: "I believe my father would have smiled with pride as I smashed my family home into the dirt."
- Parvos Granum: "My gift to the future is an idea; an idea that wealth need not settle as a crust upon the upper echelons of the populace."
- "Well. This isn't exactly how I imagined going out."
- "Guts. No worries. We've gotten out of worse. Noooo worries."
- "Let's be jovial Fill our glasses! Madness 'tis for us to think How the world is ruled by asses Nef could drive a saint to drink! HEY ho nonny nonny ho! HEY ho nonny nonny ho! HEY!"
- "Well... here's hoping one of Ticker's angels cast their eyes this way. Or I am boned."
- "I always said I'd give a lung to get off Fortuna. Looks like someone was listening."
- "Well. I've been left hanging before but this is ridiculous."
- "I knew I should have invested in quick-release joints."
- "Well, this is a hell of a time to develop an itch."
- "Oh! Hey. Hey! Mate? Would you mind? The restraints? Little help?"
- "Hey. Hey! Pop these locks, yeah? Escape a the century, mate! Escape a the century!"
- "Oi! While you're rubbernecking think maybe you could pop these locks? I need to be havin' a word with me "loyal" crew."
- "Psst! Reckon you could see your way towards y'know? Locks?"
- "Well met! Intros later. Controls are over there."
- "Oh! Well. This is a little awkward, but... would you mind helping a lady down from here?"
- "Oh. Hello. Move along, nothing to see here. Ha! I'm kidding, of course. Get me the hell down."
- "Ah! About time! So what are you? Ticker, Solaris U, my crew hired you or am I just a lucky, lucky girl?"
- "Oh at last! I feel like I was born in this thing. The controls are over there."
- "What? Who are you? Clearly not Corpus. Good enough for me. Get me the hell off this thing."
- "Ha HA! NO PRISON CAN HOLD ME!"
- "For a horrible moment that looked like becoming a career. Thanks."
- "Whenever we get off this tub I owe you a drink."
- "Hey, I know you. One of Eudico's crew? Cheers."
- "Handily done. Now, for the hard part."
- "And not a moment too soon. Right. Now to get off this tub."
**Upon freeing them in the Granum Void**
- "...got me mixed up with someone...! Wait a minute."
- "I am in your debt. Now, let's... oh what now?"
- "I'm sure an opportunity to escape will come along any second now."
- "Oh. We really [are] adrift this time. Okay. O-kay. Stay calm. Stay calm."
- "Heeey... hey? Listen. I think there's been a mistake?"
- "I knew I shouldn't have left my section this morning. I knew it. I knew it."
- "It's repo for me for sure. Uh. Um. Ah crap."
- "Happy place. Happy place. I don't have a happy place!"
- "All I can think about is all the things I'll never do. Like... NOT GETTING CAPTURED! HEEEELP!"
- "Look. I'm no hero, okay! I'll talk! I'll never stop talking! Just try and shut me up!"
- "Hey! You seem reasonable. I am reasonable. Let's be reasonable."
- "Hey. HEY! Ya gotta let me down so I can clear this up, chekchek?"
- "Ah! I can explain everything! Wait, you're not Corpus. Did Ticker send you?"
- "Hey, I'll do whatever you want, okay? Just flick that switch over there."
- "Hey! Listen. They're gonna do somethin' REAL bad to me. You gotta get me outta here."
- "Hey! HEY! Pleasepleaseplease just get me down from here, okay? They could be back at any moment!"
- "Hey! Friend? Me old cove? Let a fella down, would you? Switch over there?"
- "Oh! OH! A Tenno. Oh I'm glad to see you! You gotta get me down from here, me ol' mucker! You gotta get me down!"
- "Tenno? TENNO?! Oh yes! YES! Help me. Helpmehelpmehelpmehelpme! Help me. HELP ME!"
- "Oh! Oh thank the Void! Thank the Voooooid...."
- "Oh yes. Still on the right side of the grass. MMM'WAH."
- "Thank the Void. So, uh, now what?"
- "Now to get out of here. How do I get out of here?"
- "Aah! Oh crud! Thank you! I thought I was gonna die here!"
**Upon freeing them in the Granum Void**
- "Agh, thank the Void! You're the best, Tenno! THE BEST!"
- "I'm gettin' outta here. And when I do? Oh mate. When I do..."
- "These clowns are one mistake away from me doing something they'll regret... for about two seconds."
- "Emptying my kit was a mistake, lads. Just gives me something to carry your heads in!"
- "The next one a you bastards comes in here is leavin' with a new nickname!"
- "Info? Oh I'll give ya info. Info ya never wanted. Like knowin' the taste a yer own spleen!"
- "No-good low-down fridge-faced pack a mother-lovin' muck-suckin' dump-humpers."
- "Right. If I'm outta here in 30 seconds yer all dead. If I'm not outta here in 30 seconds you'll all wish you were!"
- "Hey, old mate. Let a cove down, yeah?"
- "Tenno! 'Bout time. Let's wreck the joint. You an' me!"
- "Nice. Switch is over there. Let's do this."
- "You're a sight for dodgy optics. Pop that lock and let's take some heads."
- "Hey. Howsabout you pop these locks and let a brother stretch his... fists?"
- "Ha! Ah yeah. Here we go. Control's over there, Tenno."
- "I never take charity but if Ticker sent ya... I'll make an exception this once."
- "Hm. Nice ta meet a fellow soldier. Control's over there."
- "Oi! Tenno. Here on business or pleasure? Pop these locks wouldja?"
- "Thanks. Need to adjust a few things, then I'm goin' after these hosers widebore."
- "Never caught your name but I never forget a face. I'll owe you one, pal."
- "Now for phase 2. I assume there's a phase 2?"
- "Thanks, old mate. I owe you one."
- "Lucky me. Front row seat to watch you work. Do lead on, mate."
**Upon freeing them in the Granum Void**
- "I'm gonna kill all a ya fridge-faced...! Wait a minute."
